name: Himematsuri EX
source:
On the first of spring in this alternate version of Tokyo,
you visit a doll shop for the Himematsuri (Princess Festival).

he shop suddenly announces, "For the next 15 minutes there will be a BF competition."

BF means "battle f*ck"!

Match off with cute young Mai-hime who serves at the shop.
Her personality is a bit ditzy. She exists to receive the affection of customers.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056568.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 在这个平行世界的东京，春天的第一天，你前往人偶店参加“姬祭”（公主祭）。店里突然宣布：“接下来的15分钟将举行BF比赛。”BF就是“Battle F*ck”（性爱对决）！你将与店里的可爱舞姬一较高下。她性格有点迷糊，存在的意义就是接受顾客的宠爱。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056568.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
